events.name: battle.trainer_mon
events.doc: battle.trainer_mon (version 4): one Pokemon of the opposing trainer's party, after the game built the party and before the battle starts.  It fires once per member, in party order.  A refusal takes the member out of the party (the last one always stays).  A changed field is written to the Pokemon with the game's own setters: a new species or level works out the stats again, a new move gets its full PP.  0 in a *mod field leaves the game's value.
events.where: the rows that build a trainer battle's setup (`battle.start`), once per opposing member
events.refuse: the member leaves the party (the last stays)
events.modify: species, level, item, moves, ability, form

events.name: battle.exp
events.doc: battle.exp (version 4): an opposing Pokemon fainted and the battle hands out experience to the party, as a whole.  It fires before mon.exp fires for each member that gains.  A refusal gives nobody any experience (and mon.exp does not fire); scale changes every member's share.
events.refuse: nobody gains

fields.name: scale

fields.name: total

events.name: heal.hp
events.doc: heal.hp (version 4): a Pokemon that has HP gets more.  The amount is the HP the game is about to add, before the cap at max_hp; a handler changes it, or refuses the event and the Pokemon gets nothing.  A fainted Pokemon coming back is mon.revive, not this event.  On the field the item is still used up: a mod that wants the item kept refuses item.use instead.
events.where: `PLIST_DEMO_RestoreHp` 0x021BE914 (ov091, an item on the field); `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ApplyHpRecover` 0x021C33E8 (ov093, every restore in a battle)
events.refuse: no HP is added

events.name: mon.revive
events.doc: mon.revive (version 4): a fainted Pokemon is about to come back.  A refusal keeps it fainted; for an item, the item is not used up.  The hp is what it comes back with, at least 1, at most max_hp.
events.where: `PLIST_DEMO_CheckItemUsable` 0x021BDD78 and `PLIST_DEMO_RestoreHp` 0x021BE914 (ov091); `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ItemEffectRevive` 0x021CC008 (ov093); before the party heals of `heal`
events.refuse: the Pokemon stays fainted; an item is kept where the game allows (`docs/mod-payloads.md`)

fields.name: hp
fields.doc: the HP it comes back with
